message.text:
The persistent entity types in the store layer appear to be the main domain structs, starting with User.

Other persistent entities include Memo, Attachment, Reaction, Inbox, MemoRelation, MemoShare, IdentityProvider, UserIdentity, and InstanceSetting. The data layer is likely the store/ package and its subpackages. I am now counting external references to each entity type.

External packages to check include server/, cmd/, and internal/. Generated code in proto/gen/ should be excluded. A script will search for direct references like `store.User` and tally unique package directories.

args.command:
bash << 'BASH'
repo=/bench/repo
entities="User Memo Attachment Reaction Inbox MemoRelation MemoShare IdentityProvider UserIdentity InstanceSetting UserSetting RowStatus Visibility Role"

for ent in $entities; do
  > /tmp/pkgset.$$
  grep -rl --include="*.go" "store\.${ent}\b\|\*store\.${ent}\b" "$repo" 2>/dev/null | while read -r f; do
    rel=${f#$repo/}
    # skip data layer paths
    case "$rel" in
      store/*) continue ;;
    esac
    # package = first 1-3 path components depending on structure
    pkg=$(echo "$rel" | awk -F/ '{ if ($1=="cmd") print $1"/"$2; else if ($1=="server") print $1"/"$2"/"$3; else if ($1=="internal") print $1"/"$2; else print $1 }')
    echo "$pkg"
  done | sort -u > /tmp/pkgset.$$
  count=$(wc -l < /tmp/pkgset.$$ | tr -d ' ')
  echo "=== store.$ent : $count packages ==="
  cat /tmp/pkgset.$$
  echo
done
BASH

args.command:
bash << 'BASH'
repo=/bench/repo
entities="User Memo Attachment Reaction Inbox MemoRelation MemoShare IdentityProvider UserIdentity Visibility Role RowStatus InboxStatus MemoRelationType"

grep -rl '"github.com/usememos/memos/store"' "$repo" --include="*.go" 2>/dev/null | while read -r f; do
  rel=${f#$repo/}
  case "$rel" in store/*) continue ;; esac
  echo "$f"
done > /tmp/store_importers.txt

echo "Importer files: $(wc -l < /tmp/store_importers.txt)"

for ent in $entities; do
  > /tmp/pkgs.$$
  while IFS= read -r f; do
    if grep -qE "store\.${ent}\b|\*store\.${ent}\b" "$f"; then
      echo "$(dirname "${f#$repo/}")"
    fi
  done < /tmp/store_importers.txt | sort -u > /tmp/pkgs.$$
  prod=$(grep -v '/test$' /tmp/pkgs.$$ | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
  all=$(wc -l < /tmp/pkgs.$$ | tr -d ' ')
  echo "$all ($prod prod) store.$ent"
  cat /tmp/pkgs.$$ | sed 's/^/  /'
  echo
done | awk '/^[0-9]/{print}'
